project: NASA Gateway — Safety Assurance and Formal Verification
central_question: How are safety-derived boundaries of local autonomy translated into formally verifiable decision and escalation rules at the interface between Module System Managers (MSMs) and the Vehicle System Manager (VSM) in NASA Gateway?
central_finding: The reviewed public documentation does not establish a complete traceability chain connecting hazard-derived autonomy boundaries to specific MSM decision and escalation rules and their corresponding verification properties.
scope_caveat: Finding concerns public documentation only. No claim about implementation status.
sources: P1 When the Eyes Don't Have It (2020)
P2 Using AGCs for Operational Verification (2023)

phase2_experimental.note: Phase II (simulation, executable artifacts) is out of scope for v1.0.0.
